## LoggingUtil.timeClear() method

Clear all active timers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
timeClear(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void

## Example


```typescript
const logger = new LoggingUtil();

logger.time("task1");
logger.time("task2");
logger.timeClear();
// All timers cleared
```
